label: Kestrel Lane Arts Trust — Studio Saturdays
covers: An activities column printed as bare discipline names — ten cells of one or two words, five of them a single word. A run that expands them into descriptive phrases ("Choir" becoming "Weekly choir rehearsals for young people") loses every one of those items while the item COUNT stays the same, so no count-based check and no snapshot diff of lengths can see it. The failure this catches is a request or prompt change that makes the model paraphrase terse cells instead of lifting them; it is on record from a real document, and no other document in this set is short enough to show it.

columns.heading: RESOURCES
items: A ground-floor studio leased from the Kestrel Lane Trust
Three sessional teaching artists paid hourly
Equipment grant from the Walmsley Family Foundation
Two decks and a mixer donated by a local radio station

items: DJ
Dance
Choir
Mural
Zine
Spoken word
Screen print
Stop motion
Beat making
Portrait photography

columns.heading: OUTPUTS
items: Forty young people attending at least ten Saturday sessions
Ten disciplines offered across the year with no gaps in provision
One end-of-year exhibition mounted in the studio
Sixty finished pieces catalogued and photographed

columns.heading: OUTCOMES
items: Young people name a discipline they intend to keep practising
Attenders report that the studio is somewhere they are known
Teaching artists retain their Saturday hours across the full year
Families attend the exhibition who had not entered the studio before
